component.name: Signet
component.summary: Keep OpenPGP keys in an encrypted vault

description.p: Signet stores OpenPGP keys in a KeePass vault and asks before signing or decrypting. Use your keys with GnuPG and Git while keeping secret key material inside the encrypted vault.
Create a vault, open an existing file, or download one from WebDAV. Import keys, share public certificates, and sync the same vault with Signet for Android.
Signet locks after an idle period and lets you approve each use of a key. The app runs in the background after its window closes.
